title: Elazar: Sages Whose Father Was Named Elazar
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rabbi Ilai son of Rabbi Elazar (Shabbat 60a); Rabbi Yochanan son of Elazar (Pesachim 51a); Rabbi Yonatan son of Elazar (Shabbat 49a); Rabbi Yitzchak son of Elazar (Shabbat 29b); Rabbi Yirmeyah son of Elazar (Berakhot 58a); Rabbi Yishmael ben Elazar (Shabbat 32a); Rabbi Nechemyah ben Elazar (Eichah Rabbah, the section beginning 'and He did not remember His footstool'); Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar, the well-known Tanna.

notes.text: The heading provides Elazar for the abbreviated patronyms. The list does not establish that all entries share a single father.
